label: Security policy, measures, risks and staff awareness by NACE Rev.2 activity

size_emp.label: Size classes in number of persons employed

nace_r2.label: Statistical classification of economic activities in the European Community (NACE Rev. 2)

label.C10-C12: Manufacture of food products; beverages and tobacco products

label.E_SECMSPSW: ICT security measure used: strong password authentication
label.E_SECMKSUD: ICT security measure used: keeping the software (including operating systems) up-to-date
label.E_SECMUIBM: ICT security measure used: authentication via biometric methods implemented by the enterprise
label.E_SECMDENC: ICT security measure used: encryption techniques for data, documents or e-mails
label.E_SECMOSBU: ICT security measure used: data backup to a separate location (including backup to the cloud)
label.E_SECMNAC: ICT security measure used: network access control (management of access by devices and users to the enterprise's network)
label.E_SECMVPN: ICT security measure used: VPN (Virtual Private Network extends a private network across a public network to enable secure exchange of data over public network)
label.E_SECMLOG: ICT security measure used: maintaining log files for analysis after security incidents
label.E_SECMRASS: ICT security measure used: ICT risk assessment, i.e. periodically assessment of probability and consequences of ICT security incidents
label.E_SECMTST: ICT security measure used: ICT security tests
label.E_SECMANY: Enterprises using any ICT security measure
label.E_SECMDUO: ICT security measure used: combination of at least two authentication mechanisms (e.g. user-defined password, one-time password (OTP), code generated via a security token or received via a smartphone, biometric methods)
label.E_SECMSMS: ICT security measure used: monitoring system that allows detecting suspicious activity in the ICT systems and alerts the enterprises about it, other than standalone anti-virus software
label.E_SECMGE1: Enterprises using any ICT security measure (as of 2022)
label.E_SECMGE3: Enterprises using at least 3 ICT security measures (as of 2022)
label.E_SECMGE5: Enterprises using at least 5 ICT security measures (as of 2022)
label.E_SECMGE7: Enterprises using at least 7 ICT security measures (as of 2022)
label.E_SECMALL: Enterprises using all ICT security measures (as of 2022)
label.E_SECPREV_CY: The enterprise's ICT security policy was defined or most recently reviewed within the last 12 months
label.E_SECPREV_1_2: The enterprise's ICT security policy was defined or most recently reviewed more than 12 months and up to 24 months ago
label.E_SECPREV_MT2: The enterprise's ICT security policy was defined or most recently reviewed more than 24 months ago
label.E_SECPREV_LE2: The enterprise's ICT security policy was defined or most recently reviewed within the last 24 months
label.E_SECPOL2: Enterprises have document(s) on measures, practices or procedures on ICT security
label.E_SECAWVTGI: Enterprises make persons employed aware of their obligations in ICT security related issues by voluntary training or internally available information (e.g. information on the intranet)
label.E_SECAWCTP: Enterprises make persons employed aware of their obligations in ICT security related issues by compulsory training courses or viewing compulsory material
label.E_SECAWCONT: Enterprises make persons employed aware of their obligations in ICT security related issues by contract (e.g. contract of employment)
label.E_SECAWANY: Enterprises make persons employed aware of their obligations in ICT security related issues
label.E_SECAWNONE: Enterprises don't make persons employed aware of their obligations in ICT security related issues
label.E_ITSEC3OWN: The ICT security related activities are carried out by the own employees
label.E_ITSEC3EXT: The ICT security related activities are carried out by external suppliers
label.E_ITSEC3: The ICT security related activities are carried out by own employees or external suppliers
label.E_SECMSMS1: ICT security measure used: monitoring system used to detect suspicious activity in the ICT systems (e.g. intrusion detection or prevention systems that monitors users’ or devices’ behaviour, network traffic) excluding standalone anti-virus software and default firewall solutions
label.E_SECAWANY_POL2: Enterprises make persons employed aware of their obligations in ICT security related issues and have document(s) on measures, practices or procedures on ICT security
